scope: Focal official preset listing demo inspected read-only through rendered browser accessibility trees. No shopper interactions, screenshot, viewport, mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Focal preset listing View demo opened Focal Theme Carbon.

claims.observed: Homepage and collection separate product categories by device generation; collection shows color, price, product type and availability facets; PDP exposes color, tech details and complementary/recommended products.
claims.risk: Visible compatibility/product copy and recommendations do not demonstrate actual device fit or recommendation behavior.
claims.vsn_guard: Validate device compatibility metadata and test recommendation relevance and variant handling.

claims.observed: Pages display sale prices, stock, review rating, leather-origin/production statements, shipping, returns and secure-payment copy.
claims.risk: Demo sample statements do not prove discount accuracy, inventory, reviews, material origin or merchant policies.
claims.vsn_guard: Tie price and stock to authoritative catalog data and substantiate review, material and fulfillment claims.
